drhp.business: Pasupati Acrylon Limited manufactures Acrylic Fibre (used in apparel, sweaters, sportswear, home furnishing and industrial cloth) and CPP packaging films (used in food & beverage, cosmetics and healthcare packaging), serving both domestic and export markets. The Company has also commissioned a grain-based Ethanol plant that sells ethanol to Oil Marketing Companies for blending with petrol under India's EBP programme.

drhp.expansion: The Company successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March 2025. It subsequently filed an application to enhance the Ethanol plant's capacity from 150 KL per day to 180 KL per day to improve operational efficiency, and has received consents from the respective departments/authorities for this enhancement.
